answer: A farm is only cheap while one proof serves many names. Ordained fibre optic splicer licence with fibre engineers endorsement breaks that: a licence engineers renew after splice audits. Each clone now carries a fresh in-person check per name that cannot be copied, priced near £25 each, so a farm of a thousand pays about £25,000, and the anchor is that the payout stays flat while the bill multiplies. The hollow an honest agent feels is a single short check; the marble a farm feels is the same check a hundred times over, with no discount for volume.
